title: 阪神JFの後に・しばしの

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu and my fans really showed their support today. I swear, I blasted down that track like I was possessed! I was so giddy afterwards, I'm sure I flashed a big ol' smile.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: After the race, Mifuyu and I promised that the next time we meet, we'll both have accomplishments to be proud of! Her in skating and me in running!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Hopefully I'll get one of those accomplishments in the Tiara tour! Next stop, the Oka Sho!
